notes: Ranks: the dictionary forms of the FrequencyWords OpenSubtitles 2018 list (top 50,000 spellings), each counted with all its inflected forms, most said first; rank = position in "words" + 1. Tokenizer fragments (single letters other than a/i/o, contraction pieces such as "ll", "didn"), subtitle markup and words without a letter are dropped and the ranks renumbered. Forms: the inflected spellings Wiktionary (via kaikki.org/Wiktextract) links to their dictionary form, as the Subtitle extension compiled them, limited to forms that are not words of their own. Levels: the lowest CEFR level (A1-C2) the CEFR-J Wordlist 1.5 (A1-B2) or the Octanove Vocabulary Profile C1/C2 1.0 teaches a headword at, spellings split on "/" and lower-cased; headwords with no rank (multi-word or rare) are kept. Families: a derived word links to the head of its word family by suffix rules gated by the profiles' parts of speech (-er/-or/-ion/-ment/-ance/-ence/-al/-ure nouns from verbs, -ness/-ity nouns and -ly adverbs from adjectives, -ful/-less adjectives from nouns, -able/-ible/-ive adjectives from verbs, with dropped e, y→i and doubled consonants), chains resolved to the ultimate head, a reviewed list of false pairs excluded; both words must be in "words". Family links are a hint, not knowledge: knowing "act" does not make "actor" known.
